[[File:Leather vambraces detail.png|left|150px]]
'''Leather vambraces''' are [[leather armour]] worn on the hands. With no requirements to equip, they are most commonly used by low-level rangers, and often mages (as there is no magic penalty). Overall they are generally a superior alternative to [[leather gloves]] with a notable exception of the [[crush]] defence, and could be considered the best "gloves" for free-to-play users who lack 40 [[Ranged]] to equip [[Green d'hide vambraces|green dragonhide vambraces]], as well as the best-in-slot mage gloves due to their lack of negative penalties.

[[Kebbit claws]] can be used on these vambraces to make [[spiky vambraces]], requiring a [[Crafting]] level of 32.
